messages:
kevin-si-lead: Heads up — Aurora SI delivery sequencing needs to be locked down. Partner expects a field surge next week; want signoff flow and rollback clear. Can we align?

maria-sr-eng: Quick context: partner is on govcloud private deploy. They'll need cert rotation window + staging creds. Jamal, do you have field availability?

jamal-field-eng: Wed/Thu next week 09:00-17:00 PST. I need ~2h for image + network verification. Can we get staging creds asap? @nina-partner-ops

nina-partner-ops: We can provision staging tomorrow EOD. Will share temp creds (72h expiry). Ports question — are 8080/8443 enough?

maria-sr-eng: Add 9000 for telemetry and 50051 for gRPC. Quick runbook snippet below for the field checks:
```
# field smoke check
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.aurora.redwood/api/health
./verify_network.sh --ports 22,80,8443,9000,50051
# if any check fails, capture logs to /var/log/aurora-field/ and upload to partner S3
```

kevin-si-lead: Two asks: (1) keep canary traffic on for 24h, fallback to host-model if quantized variant degrades; (2) field must confirm rollback steps before touching prod routes. Olivia — can you own the rollback doc + send invite for pre-field sync?

olivia-pm: On it — I'll draft rollback doc and share by EOD. Scheduling a 30m pre-field check Monday 09:30 PST; invite incoming.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: infra-provision job aurora-staging completed successfully (build#2024.03.12).

jamal-field-eng: Got creds, starting preliminary checks tomorrow morning. Will post logs here. Using quick health check: `curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://staging.aurora.redwood/api/health`

nina-partner-ops: :thumbsup: thanks — if netpolicy or cert rotation blocks anything, ping me and I'll escalate to cloud infra immediately.

kevin-si-lead: Perfect. Meeting Mon 09:30 PST confirmed. If any major blocker before then, post here and I'll escalate.
